timeline.desc: Founded in Lajpat Nagar, New Delhi with a vision to elevate government event management.
Milestone: 100th event completed. Expanded to serve 30+ Ministries across India.
Decade of excellence. 500+ events milestone. Expanded to AV and exhibition services.
1000+ events managed. 100+ Ministries & PSU served. Recognised as Delhi's premier event studio.

paragraphs: MATRO ART STUDIO was founded in 2008 with a singular vision — to bring world-class event management to India's corridors of power. Based in Lajpat Nagar, New Delhi, we have grown from a passionate startup to the most trusted name in government event management.

Over 18 years, we have built deep expertise in the unique demands of government protocol, media management, and large-scale conference organization. Our clients include 100+ Ministries and premier constitutional bodies of the Government of India.

What sets us apart is not just our capability — it's our integrity, precision, and unwavering commitment to excellence. Every event we touch reflects our belief that the moments we create become part of India's institutional memory.
